midday_start = '11:00:00'

evening_start = '17:00:00'
evening_end = '20:00:00'

SELECT station_id, datetime, o3, no2, (o3 / (o3 + no2)) AS ox_ratio
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE DATE(datetime) = '{date}'
AND o3 IS NOT NULL AND no2 IS NOT NULL
""")

    (highest_ratio_station_data['datetime'].dt.time >= pd.to_datetime(morning_start).time()) &

]['ox_ratio'].mean()
